messages:
Priya Nair: quick question  the orientation event on my calendar shows 09:00 AM PST but i'm in IST and it shows 7:30pm for me. there also seems to be a Google Meet and a Zoom invite attached, which is confusing. which is the canonical link?
Carlos Gomez: canonical is the Zoom invite from onboarding@redwood.com. there was a bug where our calendar sync created a Meet copy for some domains. please decline the Meet one.
Maya Singh: +1 had both too. also my calendar showed 09:00 but with PST label. can we standardize to PT in the subject to avoid PST/PT confusion?
Sam Rogers: noted. we'll update the event subject to "Orientation 09:00 PT / 21:30 IST / 18:00 CET" so it's explicit. working on removing the Meet attachment now.
Calendars Bot: Automated: Removed duplicate Google Meet attachment from event ID 5a8c. Updated title per request. Subscribe to Redwood Onboarding calendar: https://calendar.google.com/calendar/u/0?cid=redwood-onboarding@group.calendar.google.com
Priya Nair: thanks. for folks who imported the .ics file manually, any tips to force timezone re-sync?
Carlos Gomez: easiest is to delete the imported event then accept the invite from the onboarding calendar. if stuck, Settings > Time zone > select your local timezone in Google Calendar and refresh.
Maya Singh: fyi my colleague in APAC (SGT) can't make that time. are we recording and how soon will it be available?
Onboarding Bot: Recording will be captured and posted to the onboarding bucket within 45 minutes of session end. Transcript and auto-captions enabled (English). Retention: 60 days by default.
Priya Nair: perfect. will the recording include slides or just screen-share?
Sam Rogers: recording includes presenter video + shared slides. slides will also be uploaded separately to the Drive folder linked in the event.
Carlos Gomez: Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1RedwoodOnboardSlides. Calendly for follow-up 1:1 with hiring manager: https://calendly.com/redwood-onboard/30min
Maya Singh: slightly off-topic but noticed the event description still says "Q1 process" from last quarter. can we paste the up-to-date agenda and add a short checklist (what to install before the session)? new hires keep asking.
Sam Rogers: will add agenda + pre-req checklist (laptop image, Slack, VPN, Google SSO) to the description now. also added a line: "If you are in APAC, check the APAC-specific replay session dates" with link to alternate sessions.
Priya Nair: thanks. last bit  any guidance on captions languages? some folks requested local language captions earlier.
Onboarding Bot: Auto-captions currently English only. For accessibility requests in other languages, contact onboarding@redwood.com and we can generate translated captions within 24-48 hours after upload.
Maya Singh: thanks all. iaccepted the canonical invite and unsubscribed from the duplicate calendar. good to go. :thumbsup:
Sam Rogers: thanks everyone. action items: (1) attendees who imported .ics delete duplicates and re-accept onboarding calendar, (2) check Drive for slides, (3) ping onboarding@redwood.com for caption translations or if you need an APAC-friendly live slot.
Carlos Gomez: FYI we changed subject labels to PT (not PST) across onboarding events to avoid future confusion.
Priya Nair: appreciate it. tagging @here for folks joining next week  please verify your calendar timezone and ping if you see both Meet + Zoom.
Onboarding Bot: Reminder scheduled: 24 hours before and 15 minutes before the session.
